endpoint.description:
Optional HTTP endpoint; when set, a server is started and the agents
can subscribe to it as models.

tunables.description: Global runtime tunables; all optional with built-in defaults.

AgentConfig.description: A single agent wiring itself to the globals above.

runtime.description: Which named runtime implementation this agent's brain uses.

EndpointConfig.description:
Optional HTTP endpoint configuration: starts an OpenAI-compatible chat
server through which each subscribed agent is addressable as a model.

listen.description:
Socket address to listen on, e.g. `"127.0.0.1:8080"` or
`"0.0.0.0:8080"`. Hostnames (e.g. `"localhost:8080"`) are rejected at
startup.

ImplConfig.description: A single configured implementation: which kind plus opaque params.

Tunables.description:
Runtime tunables: channel sizes, timeouts, and backoffs. All optional;
omitted values fall back to the built-in defaults.

cancel_pumps_on_reload.description:
Cancel open pumps (streams, timers, resources, tool calls) on reload.
`false` keeps them across reload.

inbox_bound.description: How many events a single agent inbox buffers before sends fail.

interrupt_budget_ms.description: Uninterrupted runtime execution allowed after grace expires, in ms.

loop_backoff_cap_secs.description: Backoff cap for `loop` restarts on failure, in seconds.

loop_backoff_start_ms.description: Backoff start for `loop` restarts on failure, in ms.

recv_slice_ms.description: How long `recv_while` parks between early-abort checks, in ms.

recv_timeout_secs.description: How long a blocking `recv` waits before timing out, in seconds.

reload_grace_secs.description: How long the supervisor waits for a cooperative exit, in seconds.

reload_poll_ms.description: How long the blocking-call helper waits between reload checks, in ms.

session_buffer.description: How many deltas a single endpoint session buffers before drops.

watch_debounce_ms.description:
How long to coalesce the burst of file events a single save produces,
in ms.
